meta.name: apple-notes
meta.description: Manage Apple Notes via the `memo` CLI on macOS (create, view, edit, delete, search, move, and export notes). Use when a user asks CrawClaw to add a note, list notes, search notes, or manage note folders.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行创建、查看、搜索和整理 Apple Notes 笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 Apple Notes 并希望用命令行快速操作
copy.tagline_en: Create, view, search, and organize Apple Notes from the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Apple Notes and want to manage it via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 memo 命令在 macOS 上管理 Apple Notes。可以创建、查看、编辑、删除、搜索、移动笔记，以及导出为 HTML 或 Markdown 格式。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加、列出、搜索或管理笔记文件夹时触发。需要 macOS 系统且已安装 memo CLI。

say.text: 帮我创建一条笔记，标题是‘购物清单’。
say.note: 打开交互编辑器新建笔记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage Apple Notes on macOS via the `memo` CLI. It can create, view, edit, delete, search, move notes, and export to HTML or Markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add, list, search, or manage note folders. Requires macOS and the memo CLI installed.

say_en.note: Opens interactive editor to compose note.
Displays the full list of notes.
